reason: Empirical measurement study (arXiv + ACM journal DOI) quantifying non-determinism in ChatGPT code generation (up to 75.76% of tasks give zero equal test output across requests; temperature=0 does not guarantee determinism); bears on testing LLM code by motivating why its output needs testing and why test stability/flakiness must be managed, though it measures output variance, not a testing technique. Included under broad-inclusion.
